purpose: TavrWorkbench is a 3D Slicer extension for clinicians and researchers to review and edit automated TAVR (transcatheter aortic valve replacement) CT segmentations, anatomical contours, hinge points, and height measurements across a batch of cases. It also includes an annular-plane recomputation pipeline and a parametric TAVR valve mesh generator that exports placed valve models to STL.
summary: 🔴 Do not merge yet: `TavrWorkbench/CMakeLists.txt` only lists `TavrWorkbench.py` in `MODULE_PYTHON_SCRIPTS` and omits the 12 Python files under `TavrWorkbenchLib/`, causing the packaged extension to fail to load (`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'TavrWorkbenchLib'`). Additionally, `TavrWorkbench/TavrWorkbench.py` calls `vtk.vtkObject.GlobalWarningDisplayOff()` at import time, which globally silences VTK warnings for the entire Slicer process. Once `TavrWorkbenchLib/*.py` are added to `TavrWorkbench/CMakeLists.txt` (and ideally the global VTK warning suppression at import time is removed), the extension will be ready to merge.

safety.rationale: Inspected all Python modules in `TavrWorkbench/`, `TavrWorkbench/TavrWorkbenchLib/`, `TavrWorkbench/tools/`, and standalone installer scripts in `install/`. There is no telemetry, unauthorized network communication, unsafe deserialization, or command injection in the extension code.

environment.rationale: Inspected all Python files and `Resources/requirements.txt`. No packages are installed at startup or runtime (it uses only bundled numpy and SimpleITK), but `TavrWorkbench/TavrWorkbench.py` calls `vtk.vtkObject.GlobalWarningDisplayOff()` at the top level on module import, silencing VTK warnings globally for the entire Slicer session.

packaging.rationale: Inspected `CMakeLists.txt`, `TavrWorkbench/CMakeLists.txt`, and all Python imports. `TavrWorkbench/CMakeLists.txt` only installs `TavrWorkbench.py` and omits all 12 files in `TavrWorkbenchLib/`, so the packaged extension will fail to load with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'TavrWorkbenchLib'`.

license.rationale: Inspected `LICENSE.md` and `LICENSE.txt`. The repository is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), which permits verbatim redistribution by the Extensions Index, though it restricts commercial use and sharing of modified derivatives.

soundness.rationale: Inspected `TavrWorkbench.py` and all modules in `TavrWorkbenchLib/`. The code is well-structured, uses pure NumPy and SimpleITK for geometry and reslicing, writes files atomically via `.tmp` files and `os.replace`, archives previous measurements before overwriting, and cleans up MRML nodes and observers properly.

utility.rationale: Inspected `README.md`, `TavrWorkbench.py`, and `TavrWorkbenchLib/`. The extension provides a comprehensive, practical workflow for reviewing and correcting TAVR CT segmentations, contours, annular planes, and parametric valve placement, along with a unit test for contour geometry.

findings.title: TavrWorkbenchLib Python files are missing from MODULE_PYTHON_SCRIPTS in CMakeLists.txt
findings.explanation: `TavrWorkbench/TavrWorkbench.py` imports 11 modules from the `TavrWorkbenchLib/` package (`annular_plane.py`, `annulus_pipeline.py`, `cases.py`, `constants.py`, `geometry.py`, `measurement_editor.py`, `rating_table.py`, `segmentation_editor.py`, `storage.py`, `valve_generator.py`, `valve_panel.py`, and `__init__.py`), but `TavrWorkbench/CMakeLists.txt` only lists `${MODULE_NAME}.py` in `MODULE_PYTHON_SCRIPTS`. When built and packaged by the Slicer Extension build system, none of `TavrWorkbenchLib/*.py` will be installed, causing `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'TavrWorkbenchLib'` when Slicer attempts to load `TavrWorkbench`.

findings.title: Global VTK warning display disabled at module import time
findings.evidence:
# Suppress VTK warnings globally to prevent console flooding and UI freezing
vtk.vtkObject.GlobalWarningDisplayOff()
findings.explanation: At module import time (when Slicer starts up and discovers scripted modules), `TavrWorkbench.py` disables VTK warning display globally across the entire Slicer process. This affects all users and all other modules even if the user never opens `TavrWorkbench`.
findings.suggestion: Remove `vtk.vtkObject.GlobalWarningDisplayOff()` at import time, or scope warning suppression locally around specific noisy operations and restore the previous `GlobalWarningDisplay` state in a `finally:` block.

findings.title: Module category set to Examples, placeholder help URL, and outdated README
findings.evidence: self.parent.title = _("TavrWorkbench") self.parent.categories = [translate("qSlicerAbstractCoreModule", "Examples")] self.parent.dependencies = ["Segmentations", "SegmentStatistics", "Markups"] self.parent.contributors = ["Mohammed Khubaib (Saeed Lab: Florida International University)"] self.parent.helpText = _(""" A 3D Slicer extension for fast, structured review of TAVR CT segmentations and measurements. Switch between Segmentation review (approve / flag / edit masks) and Measurements review (correct annulus, SOV and STJ contours with live metrics, view heights) on the same case list. Shortcuts: Shift+A approve, Shift+F flag (current mode), Shift+Return save & next. See more information in module documentation. """)
findings.explanation: In `TavrWorkbench.py`, `self.parent.categories` is set to `"Examples"` (whereas `CMakeLists.txt` and the catalog entry use `"Segmentation"`), and `self.parent.helpText` still contains the template placeholder URL `https://github.com/organization/projectname#TavrWorkbench`. Additionally, `README.md` describes an older UI (e.g., "Directory Mode", "Centerline Slicing", and "The module installs pandas, numpy and SimpleITK automatically") that does not match the current implementation.
findings.suggestion: Set `self.parent.categories = ["Segmentation"]`, update the documentation link in `helpText` to `https://github.com/pcdslab/TavrWorkbench`, and update `README.md` to reflect the current 4-tab workflow.
